assumptions: the pinned materials are the artifacts the review read (their bytes are verified; the reading is not)
the substrate executed the check as written (ASM-SUBSTRATE-INTEGRITY)
attrs.evidence: INV-R9’s gate compared `candidate_count` to the sum of the bucket lengths — two fields of one document, both written by one author. Setting the count to 2 and truncating the buckets to match removed 33 of 35 candidates from the record with the gate still printing `every candidate is accounted for`; that mutation is registered as MUT-INTEGRATION-COUNT-AND-BUCKETS-TRIMMED and is refused. scripts/integration-delta.mjs locates each material BY CONTENT (a file whose name matches and whose bytes do not is reported as a mismatch and not used), unpacks the two review artifacts and the predecessor commit, and derives: 141 baseline claims → 176 source claims, 35 candidates, 8 shared records the source lane changed, 0 records changed by BOTH lanes, 0 candidates already present in the predecessor, 49 changed paths, 0 removed paths. Every one of those figures matches what INV-R9 asserted and what GPT-5.6 recomputed independently: the integration content was correct, and until now it was unfalsifiable. The derivation ships as mosaic/derived/integration-delta.json (kind: derived) and `node scripts/integration-delta.mjs` re-runs it and byte-compares. AND THE GATE DISTINGUISHES RECORDED FROM RE-DERIVED. The committed derivation says its materials were verified, which is a fact about the machine that generated it; INV-R9.2’s own pre-promotion simulation caught this gate trusting that field in a clean extraction where the ZIPs are absent — printing `sha256 verified` and running every derived check against a JSON file nothing had re-derived, which is the round’s defect one layer out. The materials are now located AT GATE TIME, by content, against the hashes the manifest pins. In a materials-free extraction the gate reports RECORDED, NOT RE-DERIVED and 8 checks NOT STATED.

coverage.domain: the claim-record and file deltas between the pinned source and baseline artifacts
coverage.enumerator: scripts/integration-delta.mjs over the two content-addressed artifacts and the predecessor commit

evidence_qualifiers.population: every candidate record and every changed path in every integration manifest

attrs.gap: THE MATERIALS ARE OUTSIDE THE CANONICAL BOUNDARY AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. A quarantined lane’s artifact must not enter canonical source, so the two review ZIPs are evidence attachments and not committed. Where they are absent — a clean extraction, a machine without them — every derived check reports NOT STATED and the gate says how many. An absent input is never a pass, but neither is it a proof, so this claim is established HERE and re-establishable THERE only by an auditor who has the artifacts whose hashes this file pins. Second, and it is the honest reading of the above: in the shipped artifact this claim is NOT STATED, because nothing there can re-run the derivation. It is established where the materials are and re-establishable where they are brought. Third: `changed_files` is compared by content hash with no normalization, so CLAIM_LEDGER.json is always reported changed because its `_round` pointer always differs — the disposition record carries the reason, and a normalization that hid it would be the defect this lane has chased since INV-R5.1.
attrs.prior_art: in-toto (Torres-Arias, Afzali, Kuppusamy, Curtmola & Cappos, USENIX Security 2019) names the missing structure exactly: a step emits LINK metadata recording the MATERIALS it consumed and the PRODUCTS it emitted, each bound by hash, and the LAYOUT is what makes the products answerable to the materials. INV-R9 recorded materials and asserted products. Read narrowly: in-toto’s layouts are SIGNED and this artifact has no signature — FAC-RECEIPT-AUTH is still open — so what is borrowed is the materials/products shape, not the authentication.
attrs.review_focus: Is `derivable: none` an honest state, or does shipping a committed derivation that most verifiers cannot re-run amount to a self-report with extra steps?
attrs.statement: An integration manifest’s candidate population and file delta are RECOMPUTED from the content-addressed materials it pins, and the authored dispositions are checked against that recomputation by set membership. A manifest may not be the only account of the delta it disposes of.
